services.title: Complete home interiors
services.summary: Create a consistent material palette, lighting plan and approach to storage across your apartment or villa. We begin with the rooms you use most and consider how they connect before working through individual details.

services.title: Modular kitchens
services.summary: Plan preparation space, appliance placement and storage around the way you cook. Choose worktops, cabinet finishes and task lighting with daily use and upkeep in mind.

services.title: Living rooms
services.summary: Arrange seating, lighting and circulation around everyday family time and the way you host. Layer the lighting so the room can shift from daytime use to a quieter evening setting.

services.title: Bedroom interiors
services.summary: Shape a room around rest, with light where you read, discreet storage and enough clear space to move comfortably around the bed.

services.title: Wardrobes
services.summary: Set out hanging space, drawers and shelves around what you wear and how you access it. Select door styles and finishes to suit the room's proportions and layout.

services.title: Home offices
services.summary: Give work its place at home with a well-positioned desk, comfortable task lighting and planned storage. Consider power and cable access early, especially when the space serves another purpose outside working hours.

process.title: Free Consultation
process.description: Share the floor plan, property location and handover timing. Tell us how you want the home to feel and which rooms you want to address first.

process.title: Requirement Discussion
process.description: Agree the rooms, priorities and budget range. Include the furniture, appliances or finishes you intend to carry into the new design.

process.title: Design Planning
process.description: Review layouts and the design direction together. Use the plan to discuss circulation, storage and lighting before moving into detailed selections.

process.title: Material Selection
process.description: Review finish and hardware samples against the design and agreed budget. Consider how the materials will look in the room's light and how you'll care for them.

process.title: Execution
process.description: Once the scope and site readiness are agreed, we coordinate the work included in your project and discuss the stages that need your input.

process.title: Final Handover
process.description: Walk through the completed scope together and review the finish, fittings and any agreed outstanding items.
